title: Cocartesian comparison for the inverse image of an inner horn
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, standard simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]. Let $q:\mathcal C\to\Delta^N$ be an inner fibration from a quasicategory and let $0<i<N$. Assume that for every $x\in\mathcal C_{i-1}$ there is a $q$-cocartesian edge $x\to y$ with $y\in\mathcal C_i$, lying over the edge $i-1\to i$. Then
$$\mathcal C\times_{\Delta^N}\Lambda_i^N\longrightarrow\mathcal C$$
is a categorical equivalence and a monomorphism. No cocartesian lifts over other edges of $\Delta^N$ and no colimits in $\mathcal C$ are assumed.

source.place: Lemma 2.4.4.6, printed p. 307 and its proof; used in Lemma 3.1.3.16, printed p. 347. Nonsymmetric formulation following Gepner–Haugseng, arXiv:1312.3178v4 Appendix A. Read online; archive WANTED. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical fact.
